title.zh: 将Kiañgan医院正式更名为Ifugao医院的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Kiañgan Hospital to Ifugao Hospital
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Kiañgan Hospital to Ifugao Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Bệnh viện Kiañgan thành Bệnh viện Ifugao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงพยาบาล Kiañgan เป็นโรงพยาบาล Ifugao
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Rumah Sakit Kiañgan menjadi Rumah Sakit Ifugao
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Hospital Kiañgan kepada Hospital Ifugao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2146_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Kiañgan Hospital in the Municipality of Ifugao, Mountain Province, is hereby changed to Ifugao Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
